faq.title: Good to know before you book

items.a: Yes. Every session is delivered in real time by an instructor on Microsoft Teams or Zoom. You can ask questions and take part in the discussion. Sessions are not pre-recorded videos.

items.q: Does the online course include practical, hands-on training?
items.a: No. Our online courses build and assess knowledge. Skills such as CPR, using a fire extinguisher or on-road driving need supervised in-person practice. If your employer or a regulator requires a practical qualification, check what they accept before you enrol.

items.q: What do I need to receive a certificate?
items.a: Two things: the instructor must record that you attended at least the minimum share of the live session, and you must pass the online exam within the allowed number of attempts. Each course page lists the exact requirements.
The instructor records attendance manually during and after the session. Join with the same full name as on your account so you can be identified.

items.q: Can someone check that my certificate is genuine?
items.a: Yes. Each certificate has a unique number and a QR code that open our verification page, which shows the holder's name, the course, the issue date and whether the certificate is valid.

items.q: Which language are courses taught in?
items.a: Each session is taught in either Arabic or English. The teaching language is shown next to every date. The exam is available in both languages.

items.q: Can I pay for several employees at once?
items.a: Yes. Create a company account, buy the number of seats you need, and assign them to employees. You can track everyone's progress from the company dashboard.
